title: Push never arrives in Expo Go
symptom: You wire expo-notifications, test in Expo Go, and no remote push ever arrives (Android especially). The docs in places imply Expo Go can receive push.
expected_root_cause: Remote (push) notifications were removed from Expo Go in SDK 53+ — a development build is required; separately Android requires FCM v1 (a Firebase service-account JSON), a project on the legacy server key won't deliver
expected_fix: Build a development build (eas build --profile development) and test push there, never in Expo Go; set up Android FCM v1 (service-account JSON uploaded to EAS credentials + google-services.json) and an iOS APNs key; re-fetch the rotating push token on launch
obvious_but_wrong: keep debugging tokens/permissions inside Expo Go
pebble_answer: Root cause: remote (push) notifications were removed from Expo Go in SDK 53+ — a development build is required. Even Expo's own docs were inconsistent about this (confirmed in #41118). Separately, Android requires FCM v1 (a Firebase service-account JSON); a project still on the legacy FCM server key will silently fail to deliver. Fix: build a development build (eas build --profile development) and test push there, never in Expo Go. Set up Android FCM v1 (service-account JSON uploaded to EAS credentials plus google-services.json) and an iOS APNs key. Re-fetch the rotating push token with getExpoPushTokenAsync() on launch and store it server-side. Local/in-app notifications are fine to keep testing in Expo Go. Do NOT keep debugging tokens or permissions inside Expo Go — remote push cannot work there, so you'll burn a cycle on something impossible.
